mechanism: External stop/liquidation pools define location and destination; direct post-raid aggressive-flow and price-progress state adjudicates acceptance, absorption/rejection or flat.

external_pool.definition: nearest still-unconsumed causal 15m radius-2 confirmed swing high and low
external_pool.consumption: first observed 500ms trade bucket strictly through the level

state.window: single completed five-second calendar window beginning at raid bucket
state.outside_dwell: fraction of observed bucket closes beyond source

actions.entry: first observed 500ms trade price after state completion plus fixed 500ms
actions.accept_target: next pre-existing active external pool in raid direction
actions.accept_stop: opposite extreme of completed state window plus one tick
actions.reject_stop: raid/state outward extreme plus one tick
actions.state_exit: completed five-second reversal of the accepted/rejected state

chronology.official_2024_2026: sealed unless fixed-rule fatal screen passes

pass_gate: positive non-sparse PF>1 24bp path in development and confirmation, also positive after exact top-10%-positive-event deletion with full rerouting
ml: closed until base fixed-rule economics pass
